parameters: \w[signskin]Any Pokémon that appears even once\nin a battle is awarded EXP Points.
\w[signskin]To raise a weak Pokémon, put it at the\nleft of the team list.
\w[signskin]As soon as a battle starts, switch it\nout. It will earn EXP Points without\nbeing exposed to any harm.
\bIf your Pokémon are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\nof tall grass.
